summary: Retest of iteration_125 fixes (KISS Round 4 Materials) plus a regression pass, backend and UI, as owner and sales. All 5 fixes verified. (1) Badge agreement: quick-counts returns needs_ordering_ids, and its length equals counts.needs_ordering. It equals the ids from ?quick=needs_ordering and contains short_for_jobs_ids. The list shows 312 short-badge + 2 low-badge ('Needs ordering') = 314, matching the card count. Detail badges match for 7 materials: 2 short, 2 order-only, 3 OK, including a9d6453c (avail 0 / thr 0), which shows OK in both the list and the detail page for owner and sales. (2) Loading state: materials-refreshing ('Updating…') plus dimmed table appear on quick-card click and on clear when old rows are shown. Rows end up equal to the count for all 4 cards. Rapid switching (needs->on_order->short) and clear->arriving end on the right rows, so stale responses are ignored. Typing 9 characters in search sent 1 /materials request (debounced). (3) Opening the page loads quick-counts + facets + materials only, with no /purchase-orders call. The PO tab shows pos-loading and then fetches /purchase-orders once. After Receive, only /purchase-orders and quick-counts are fetched; receiving 3/8 showed '3 / 8' and outstanding 5. (4) A submitted PO's status select shows 'submitted', and its options list starts with 'submitted'. 30 'partially received' labels and no labels with underscores. (5) Product Catalog has one back control, catalog-back 'Materials', which goes to /inventory; the header link and '← Inventory' are gone. Regression passed: Manage menu items (locations, transactions, CSV, ABC templates, add material, bulk mode + bulk edit), row actions (edit/adjust/delete menu), PO filters (open 1583 / received 615 / cancelled 13 / all 2211), ABC order panel, ABC history toggle, 6 detail tabs, Suppliers (136 rows), Home 'Material problems & deliveries' card, and Jobs material status (793 cells). Sales sees no Manage menu, row actions, status selects or Receive. Backend: 15/15 pass. One test failed once from a race with the parallel lifecycle class in the same file and passed on rerun.

integration_issues.issue: Now refreshes only POs + counts, as intended. In the browser it still took ~9s from clicking Receive until po-received updated: the receive POST takes 0.1s, but GET /purchase-orders is 3.3MB / ~2.3s, and then 2211 rows re-render. Optional: update the received row from the receive response first, then refresh in the background.

issues: Non-editable statuses like 'submitted' have no colour in the sc map, so the badge is plain (cosmetic).
The table shows only headers and no loading indicator for the first ~3+ seconds while 1204 rows load (pre-existing).

action_items: Optional: show the receive result in the PO row right away instead of waiting for the 3.3MB /purchase-orders reload.
Optional: add colours for submitted/confirmed/shipped etc. to the PO status badge map, and a loading row to the Product Catalog table.
critical_code_review_comments: Inventory.jsx setPoStatus, PODialog onCreated and AbcOrderPanel onChanged still call load(), which refetches the full ~5s materials list plus POs. Only POs + counts are needed there.
The OK badge in the materials list has no data-testid; short-badge/low-badge have one. Add e.g. ok-badge-{id} for test symmetry.
Inventory.jsx is 559 lines and close to the 700-line limit.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15; 1 flaky race on first run, passed on rerun)
